title: agentdoc.cloud.export_native_fact.v0
description: Native JSON serialization for records without retained wire bytes. Kind and every record field are fixed by explicit native inventory arms. Native JSON-valued columns retain their admitted JSON values; this schema is not a data-access selector or an independent historical byte attestation. Every integer precision-sensitive column is serialized as a string. The replay-posture variant names its source assertion directly.

preparation_validation.description: Unchanged nested validation JSON metadata projection from the original prepare output. No raw diagnostics/source and no original prepare wire-byte claim.
